title: 1-Ingredient Creamy Banana Nice Cream
hookLine: Whipped frozen bananas transform into glossy soft-serve gelato with zero added sugar or dairy.

items.name: Splash of almond milk + cacao nibs (optional)

steps.title: Line Freezer Tray & Prep Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Line a rimmed baking sheet or loaf pan with parchment paper so your frozen treat lifts out cleanly. Measure out {nc_ban} and keep toppings like {nc_add} prepped within reach.

steps.title: Blend Frozen Bananas Until Glossy
steps.instructionTemplate: Blend {nc_ban} and {nc_add} in a food processor, scraping down sides, until suddenly silky soft-serve texture forms. Chill or freeze until completely firm and set, then portion into 2 servings and store leftovers in an airtight container.
steps.creatorSecret: Use speckled sweet bananas—the riper they are, the creamier and sweeter your nice cream!

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {nc_add} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Freeze Solid, Portion & Enjoy
steps.instructionTemplate: Freeze 1-Ingredient Creamy Banana Nice Cream flat until completely solid, then let sit 3 minutes at room temperature before slicing, snapping, or scooping into 2 servings. Store leftovers in a freezer-safe container.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero refined sugar and only 150 cal—tastes like total indulgence!
